main_body: Green sofa: a tall backrest panel, a dark band, a seat cushion band with a centre seam, a dark front base, and two small legs
top_band: Reading the middle column: light green rows 1-5 (the backrest face), dark green rows 6-7, light green rows 8-11 (the cushion, with a vertical seam), dark green rows 12-14. No distinct top surface is separated from the front by an edge line.
evidence: The sofa is drawn straight on, like an architectural elevation. The backrest, cushions and base are stacked vertical faces. The light band at rows 8-11 reads as a cushion front, since a vertical seam at x≈19 cuts through it, so it is not a seat surface seen from above. Nothing foreshortened shows the seat or the backrest top. This matches the 'front elevation' and 'thin seat' red guide cases.

style.evidence: The sofa uses only about 3 flat greens (light, mid, dark) with no texture dots, stitching, grain or per-cushion highlights. The large light-green panels (backrest and seat) are single flat fills well over 5x5 px. The tiles carry only 2-4 colours, so it is much thinner than the stall and well references.
